messages:
maria: FYI hitting duplicated downstream webhooks from the onboarding sample app when a 429 happens during token refresh. Seen this twice in the wild this morning.
ben: ugh, can you paste a minimal repro or logs?
maria: repro steps: 1) start sampleapp with demo creds 2) trigger burst of requests to /generate 3) force auth refresh (rotate token) 4) server returns 429 for a subset. After retry we see the same webhook processed twice.
carol: do we have idempotency keys in that sample? last I checked the JS sample didn't set one for the webhook flow.
maria: nope, sample uses naive retry. here's the snippet where we call the SDK: ```js
await client.generate({ prompt }); // no idempotency header set
```
sam: @maria can you confirm if the SDK is re-sending the original request body on 429 or replaying after refresh? that distinction matters for safe-replay semantics.
maria: looks like the client-level retry sends the same body after token rotate; the server interprets it as a fresh request. So double side-effect.
ben: we should add guidance + a toggle in the sample to opt into a "replay-signal" header that indicates this might be a retry after a 429. server can use that to dedupe.
carol: agree. alternate approach: sample should demonstrate adding an idempotency-key header on first send and persist it across retries. show both patterns in sample app.
sam: also logging: the SDK currently logs only "retrying on 429" without attaching a correlation id. if we include a small correlation header like `x-rw-replay-id` it helps tracing.
maria: +1. propose small patch in sample: add idempotency-key by default and a feature flag REPLAY_SIGNAL=false. when true we emit `x-rw-replay-signal: 1` on retries. when false we still show idempotency usage.
ben: sound plan. can we make the SDK expose a safeReplay window config too? e.g., `safeReplayWindowMs` that limits client-side replay for requests flagged non-idempotent.
carol: yes, default like 5_000ms and document caveats for webhooks/external side-effects.
devex-bot: NOTE: linked issue created — #3482 add replay-signal toggle + idempotency sample (maria)
maria: I'll open the PR after lunch. Patch will include tests to simulate token rotation + 429 and ensure only one webhook processed.
sam: chemo check: add a telemetry event `sdk.replay_attempt` with replay_id and original_ts (no PII) so we can correlate with server dedupe metrics.
ben: once PR is up I'll review. quick interim: add a short warning in sample README: "Without idempotency keys, 429 + token refresh can cause duplicate side-effects."
maria: added that line in a follow-up commit locally, will push. :thumbsup:
carol: thanks all. nice low-friction DX fix.
ben: runbook note: if customer reports duplicate processed items, ask for `x-rw-replay-id` and server logs matching it.
maria: filed the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/512 — includes tidy docs + tests.
ben: reviewed and left small nits. will merge after CI. :white_check_mark:
carol: awesome. follow-up item: draft a short blog/KB about safe replay patterns for onboarding OSS samples.
maria: on it.
